key_concepts: Dogs and cats can be pets, companions, and protectors
Dogs guard homes and use their sense of smell to trace objects and people
Horses can be used for transportation
Farmers raise animals like cattle and goats for livelihood
Hens and ducks provide eggs as a protein source
Fish and meat from animals provide nutritious food
Goat and sheep hair is used for woolen clothing, shawls, and blankets
Animal skin or body coverings can be made into leather products like bags and belts
Animal dung can be used as organic manure to keep soil fertile
Wildlife animals help maintain ecological balance
